findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: appraise_listing · Private data: copro_at_address · Public sink: commune_profile, appraise_listing, ptz.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: appraise_listing · Private data: copro_at_address · Public sink: commune_profile, appraise_listing, ptz

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
